title.zh: 可错科学辨别的必要信息条件
title.en: Necessary information conditions for fallible scientific discrimination

claim.zh: 有限加权辨别的作答覆盖不超过两种错误权重与证据差异之和；保持相同读数的适应关系不能同时达到更强覆盖和错误指标。
claim.en: Finite weighted discrimination has commitment coverage at most the two error weights plus evidence separation; adaptive relations preserving the same readouts cannot also meet stronger coverage/error claims.

hypotheses.zh: 二元目标意义、有限自然数权重表和完整实际可用输入；概率解释另需两侧同一正总量。
hypotheses.en: Intended binary target, finite natural-weight tables and complete actually available inputs; probability interpretation additionally requires equal positive marginal totals.

hypotheses.zh: 配对版本使用有效配对和共同读者；直接边缘版本不需指定配对。
hypotheses.en: The paired version uses a valid pairing and common reader; the direct marginal version needs no chosen coupling.

hypotheses.zh: 适应性结论使用初态关系、每步关系保持及关联状态的相同读数；不同状态类型获准。
hypotheses.en: The adaptive conclusion uses initial relatedness, step preservation and identical readouts on related states; different state types are allowed.

correspondence.zh: 从同一展开分化出问题、保留证据及回应；定理检验所声明的辨别成就，不定义科学为接受本理论。
correspondence.en: Questions, retained evidence and responses differentiate within one unfolding; the theorem tests a declared discrimination achievement rather than defining science as acceptance of this theory.

detail.zh: 不作答可无错误但无辨别覆盖；正确猜中不能保证两侧可靠，遗漏实际输入会使应用失效。
detail.en: Abstention can avoid errors without discrimination coverage; a lucky answer does not ensure two-case reliability, and omitted actual inputs invalidate an application.

limitations.zh: 有限自然数权重、完整读数、共同规则及实际概率对应明示；没有校准真实法则或证明整个核心的科学普遍必要性。
limitations.en: Finite natural weights, complete readouts, a common rule and actual probability correspondence are explicit; no calibration of actual laws or science-wide necessity of the whole core is proved.

validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 实编18项定理／27项声明审计：11空、16标准依赖；无自定公理或经典选择。没有新增经验数据或独立评审。
validation_scope.en: Lean 4.29.1 compiled 18 theorems / 27 declaration audits: 11 empty, 16 standard dependency lists; no custom postulates or classical choice. No new empirical data or independent review.

next_delta.zh: 明确尚需科学普遍必要性证明的核心承诺，并给出独立问题、对应及真正对手；不把此次局部证明升级为全理论完成。
next_delta.en: Identify the further core commitment requiring a science-wide necessity proof, with an independent task, correspondence and substantive rival; do not upgrade this local proof to whole-theory completion.

history.zh: 2026-10-08：迁移既有 I1/I2 及不作答论证，并新增有限权重形式证据和适应接续；18项新形式定理不是18项独立发现。
history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing I1/I2 and abstention reasoning with new finite-weight formal evidence and adaptive composition; 18 new formal theorems are not 18 independent discoveries.
